target: Jean kiarail nagh duittym er y chassan rioee.

source: The government decided to lower taxes.
target: Ren y reiltys coontey dy injillaghey keeshyn.

source: Please lower the volume on the radio.
target: Injillaghey yn towse er y radio, my sailt.

source: The pilot will lower the landing gear soon.
target: Injillaghey yn looder yn greie tarlheanee dy gerrit.

source: The diver will go under the surface of the water.
target: Gow fo yn thummeyder eaghtyr yn ushtey.

source: Did the submarine go under the ice cap?
target: Ren y fo-vooir gow fo'n chappan rioee?

source: We watched the sun go down below the horizon.
target: Ren shin jeeaghyn er y ghrian gow fo'n chruinnaght.

source: The tide will ebb in a few hours.
target: Traih yn roayrt ayns kuse dy ooraghyn.

source: The water level in the lake began to subside after the long summer.
target: Hoshiaght towse yn ushtey 'sy logh dy hraihey lurg y tourey liauyr.

source: We watched the river run dry slowly during the drought.
target: Ren shin jeeaghyn er yn awin traih dy moal car y drogh-heeraght.

source: The wind will blow strongly tonight.
target: Sheidey yn gheay dy niartal noght.

source: The car can go fast along the motorway.
target: Foddee yn gleashtan sheidey rish y raad mooar.

source: Did the boat go fast across the bay so quickly?
target: Ren y baatey sheidey harrish y vaie cha tappee?

source: The cat will sneak through the long grass.
target: Sheygin y kayt trooid y faiyr liauyr.

source: He tried to go furtively past the guard unnoticed.
target: Ren eh geabbey dy sheygin harrish y wardeyr gyn enney.

source: They had to sneak into the old house at night.
target: Shegin daue sheygin stiagh 'sy çhenn thie 'syn oie.

source: His eyes began to goggle with surprise.
target: Hoshiaght e hooillyn dy volg lesh yindys.

source: The fish's eyes seemed to bulge out of its head.
target: Va my shilley dy volg ass e chione.

source: Don't goggle your eyes at me like that!
target: Nagh bolg dty hooillyn orrym myr shen!

source: She started to goggle her eyes at the strange sight.
target: Hoshiaght ee dy volgaghey e hooillyn ec y reayrt quaagh.

source: Why do you goggle your eyes when you are angry?
target: Cre'n fa dy vel oo bolgaghey dty hooillyn tra t'ou corree?

source: The child would goggle his eyes in amazement.
target: Volgaghey yn paitçhey e hooillyn lesh yindys.

source: Please enter the building quietly.
target: Entreil yn troggal dy kiune, my sailt.

source: Did you enter the competition last year?
target: Ren oo entreil 'sy cho-streeu y vlein shoh chaie?

source: The key will enter the lock easily.
target: Entreil yn ogher 'sy ghlass dy aashagh.

source: We must go in search of the lost sheep.
target: Shegin dooin shirrey son ny kirree caillt.

source: The explorers will go in search of ancient ruins.
target: Shirrey son ny ronseyderyn shenn-charraghyn.

source: Did you go in search of a new job?
target: Ren oo shirrey son obbyr noa?

source: The students will enter the classroom.
target: Entreil ny studeyryn 'sy çhamyr-scoill.

source: Let's go into the discussion about the new policy.
target: Lhig dooin entreil 'sy resoonaght mychione y pholasee noa.

source: The river will enter the sea further downstream.
target: Entreil yn awin 'sy cheayn ny s'odjey sheese yn awin.

source: We need to investigate the matter thoroughly.
target: Ta feme ain dy ronsaghey yn cooish dy bollagh.

source: The detective will go into the crime scene.
target: Ronsaghey yn ronseyder yn ynnyd-loght.

source: Let's explore the history of the island.
target: Lhig dooin ronsaghey shennaghys yn ellan.

source: The king had to go into exile after the rebellion.
target: Shegin da'n ree shiaulley stiagh ayns eebyrtys lurg y hroggal.

source: Many people had to sail from their homeland during the war.
target: Shegin da ram sleih shiaulley veih nyn gheer ghooinney car y chaggey.

source: Will he sail to a new country for safety?
target: Shiaulley eh gys çheer noa son sauçhys?

source: They decided to gold plate the old statue.
target: Ren ad coontey dy airhey yn shenn jalloo.

source: The craftsman will gold plate the silver chalice.
target: Airhey yn cheirdagh y chalys argid.

source: Can you gold plate this small locket for me?
target: Foddee oo airhey yn locket veg shoh dou?

source: The flowers began to go limp in the heat.
target: Hoshiaght ny blaaghyn dy speir 'sy çhiass.

source: His arm went limp after the long struggle.
target: Hie e roih speir lurg y streeu liauyr.

source: The old flag will go limp in the calm air.
target: Speir y shenn vrattagh 'sy gheyyr chiune.

source: The alarm clock will go off at seven o'clock.
target: Bwoalley yn clag-doostee ec shiaght er y chlag.

source: Did the fire alarm go off during the night?
target: Ren yn clag aile bwoalley car yn oie?

source: The bell will go off to signal the end of class.
target: Bwoalley yn clag dy chowraghey jerrey y chlass.

source: The old gun might go off if you fire it.
target: Foddee yn shenn ghunney polt my vel oo cur aile da.

source: Did the firework go off too early?
target: Ren y phollt-aile polt ro-leah?

source: Be careful, the cracker could go off unexpectedly.
target: Jean kiarail, foddee yn cracker polt gyn jerrey.

source: The bomb will go off in ten minutes.
target: Bleaystey yn bomm ayns jeih minnidyn.

source: We heard the firecracker go off in the street.
target: Chual shin y phollt-aile bleaystey 'sy traid.

source: Did the old mine go off when they touched it?
target: Ren y shenn vooin bleaystey tra ren ad bentyn rish?

source: He will go off on holiday next week.
target: Immee eh ersooyl er laaghyn seyrey y nah hiaghtin.

source: Did the train go off without us?
target: Ren y traen immee ersooyl gyn shin?

source: The children will go off to play outside.
target: Immee ny paitçhyn ersooyl dy chloie mooie.

source: Please go on with your story.
target: Lhian lesh dty skeeal, my sailt.

source: The rain will go on all day.
target: Lhian y fliaghey feie'n laa.

source: Did the meeting go on for a long time?
target: Ren y çhaglym lhian rish foddey?

source: They decided to go on a long journey.
target: Ren ad coontey dy goaill er turrys liauyr.

source: Will you go on this new project?
target: Goaill oo er y phroject noa shoh?

source: Let's go on the challenge together.
target: Lhig dooin goaill er y cho-streeu ry-cheilley.

source: The concert will go on at eight o'clock.
target: Toshiaghey yn consert ec hoght er y chlag.

source: When will the work go on on the new bridge?
target: Cuin toshiaghey yn obbyr er y droghad noa?

source: Did the game go on without us?
target: Ren y ghamman toshiaghey gyn shin?

source: Please go out through the back door.
target: Gow magh trooid y dorrys cooyl, my sailt.

source: Did you go out last night?
target: Ren oo gow magh riyr?

source: The light will go out when the power fails.
target: Gow magh y sollys tra ta'n pooar failleil.

source: The tide will go out completely by midnight.
target: Traih yn roayrt dy bollagh roish mean-oie.

source: We watched the water drain from the pool.
target: Ren shin jeeaghyn er yn ushtey traih ass y phooill.

source: Did the river run dry during the dry season?
target: Ren yn awin traih car y traa çhirrym?

source: We need to go over the details of the plan.
target: Ta feme ain dy filley er ash harrish myn-chooishyn y phlan.

source: Did you go back to the old house?
target: Ren oo filley er ash gys y shenn thie?

source: Let's go over the main points of the lesson.
target: Lhig dooin filley er ash harrish ny poyntyn smoo jeh'n lessoon.

source: We must review the budget carefully.
target: Shegin dooin jean aavriwnys y vudget dy kiarailagh.

source: Did you go over your notes before the exam?
target: Ren oo jean aavriwnys dty noteyn roish y scrudeyrys?

source: The committee will review the proposal next week.
target: Jean aavriwnys y choonseil y choyrtys y nah hiaghtin.

source: Be careful not to fall over the edge.
target: Jean kiarail nagh duittym harrish y cheim.

source: The old wall might fall over in the strong wind.
target: Foddee yn shenn voalley tuittym harrish 'sy gheay niartal.

source: Did the child fall over the toy?
target: Ren y paitçhey tuittym harrish y ghreien?

source: We need to go over the bridge.
target: Ta feme ain dy gow harrish y droghad.

source: Did you go over the main points in the report?
target: Ren oo gow harrish ny poyntyn smoo 'sy recortys?

source: Let's go over the border into the next country.
target: Lhig dooin gow harrish y joarey stiagh 'sy nah heer.

source: The car will go past the house soon.
target: Gow harrish y gleashtan y thie dy gerrit.

source: Did you go past the shop on your way here?
target: Ren oo gow harrish y shapp er dty raad gys shoh?

source: We watched the parade go past the town square.
target: Ren shin jeeaghyn er y varraney gow harrish y voayl baljagh.
